description: Optimize the cubic Pa-3 bulk structure of iron disulfide.
user_prompt: Optimize the cubic (Pa-3) bulk structure of iron disulfide (FeS2). Report the final converged energy and lattice constant.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: Pyrite FeS2 conventional cubic bulk cell with space group Pa-3; FeS2 formula unit is one Fe and two S atoms.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-226 PBE energy per atom multiplied by three atoms per FeS2 formula unit. The Materials Project reference uses Fe_pv and S PAW potentials. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constant is left as a diagnostic because the accepted energy is tied to MP PAW/PBE conventions. Materials Project applies GGA+U mixing to selected transition-metal oxides and fluorides, so this sulfide case is treated as nonmagnetic PBE; the +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, and smearing differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
